llmPreferences.title: LLM Preferences
llmPreferences.sectionTitle: AI Assistant Chat — how to configure a provider
llmPreferences.intro.subtitle: Here you connect the AI Assistant to an artificial intelligence service using your own account (the product does not include a built-in key).
llmPreferences.intro.body: Without at least one saved and enabled configuration, the chat cannot reply. Each configuration stores access details for a provider (for example OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini).
llmPreferences.intro.fieldsTitle: What each field means when you add a configuration:
llmPreferences.intro.field.nombre: Name: how you want to recognize this configuration in the list (e.g. «OpenAI office»).
llmPreferences.intro.field.proveedor: Provider: the AI company or service you will use.
llmPreferences.intro.field.modelo: Model: which assistant variant to use (pick a suggested one or type another if your account allows it).
llmPreferences.intro.field.secreto: Secret / API key: the private key from your provider. Keep it confidential; do not share it.
llmPreferences.intro.field.baseUrl: Base URL: only if the provider or a custom installation requires it (shown when needed).
llmPreferences.intro.field.enabled: Enabled: when checked, this configuration can be used in the chat.
llmPreferences.intro.helpLink: After you select a provider, if help is available you will see a link to the provider’s site to obtain or review the credentials you need.
llmPreferences.intro.steps: Suggested order: Add → choose provider → use the help link if you need it → fill in model and API key → Save. Later you can edit, disable, or delete items from the list.

llmPreferences.empty.body: Add an LLM credential for the AI Assistant.

llmPreferences.fields.nombre.tooltip: A name to recognize this configuration in the list. It can be the provider, the use, or the team (e.g. «OpenAI office» or «Gemini tests»). It does not change how the assistant replies.
llmPreferences.fields.proveedor.tooltip: The AI company or service you will use (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or another compatible one). After you select it, suggested models may appear and, when available, a link to get credentials on the provider’s site.
llmPreferences.fields.modelo.tooltip: The specific assistant variant within the provider (for example a faster or a more accurate model). You can pick a suggested option or type another if your provider account allows it.
llmPreferences.fields.secreto.tooltip: The private key from your provider that authorizes usage. It is stored securely and is not shown again. Keep it confidential; do not share it. If you do not know where to get it, use the provider help link.
llmPreferences.fields.baseUrl.tooltip: Web address of the service when you are not using the provider’s standard endpoint (for example a self-hosted or OpenAI-compatible server). Shown only if the selected provider requires it; if unsure, check the help link documentation.
llmPreferences.fields.supportsVision.too: Shows whether this model can analyze images as well as text. It is filled automatically from the provider and model; you do not need to change it.
llmPreferences.fields.enabled.tooltip: When checked, this configuration can be used in the chat. If unchecked, it stays saved but the assistant will not use it until you enable it again.
llmPreferences.secretKeptHint: Leave empty to keep the current secret.
llmPreferences.helpLink.tooltip: Opens the selected provider’s site to create an account, generate an API key, or learn how to get the credentials.
llmPreferences.baseUrlRequired: Base URL is required for this provider.
